dedupe_keys.name: synthetic net3 water pipe assets and yearly failures

description: This folder publishes synthetic pipe assets and failure histories built on the EPANET Example Network 3. It contains Net3.inp, a pipe-geometry GeoPackage and Synthetic_assets_and_failures_from_Net3.csv. The repository README lists pipe identifiers, installation year, length, material, diameter, service connections and several spatial or environmental attributes, followed by annual synthetic failure fields from 2007 through 2024. The GeoPackage includes compatibility columns for entity ID, construction year, diameter and material. The authors attribute the underlying Net3 example to the US Environmental Protection Agency and the OpenWaterAnalytics EPANET repository. The folder is public, and GitHub metadata and the README state BSD-3-Clause for this repository; reuse of the upstream example should retain its stated attribution. A modeller could test pipe-network feature extraction, gap-time training and maintenance-risk scenarios with these files. The rows are synthetic and the original utility failures are not published, so this collection cannot calibrate real failure rates or establish model accuracy in the field. File contents, row counts, generator settings and coordinate reference were not inspected.
